title: hibiscus sharpei
intro: Hibiscus sharpei, commonly known as the Puna hibiscus, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the mallow family and is native to the Hawaiian Islands. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering several health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as a natural diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Hibiscus sharpei include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to protect against cell damage and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in Hibiscus sharpei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
